+def test_n_neighbors_datatype():
+    """Test that n_neighbors must be an integer."""
+    X = np.array([[0., 0.], [1., 1.]])
+    
+    # Test float n_neighbors in __init__
+    assert_raises(TypeError, neighbors.NearestNeighbors, n_neighbors=3.)
+    
+    # Test float n_neighbors in kneighbors
+    nn = neighbors.NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=3)
+    nn.fit(X)
+    assert_raises(TypeError, nn.kneighbors, X, n_neighbors=3.)
+    
+    # Test negative n_neighbors in __init__
+    assert_raises(ValueError, neighbors.NearestNeighbors, n_neighbors=-1)
+    
+    # Test zero n_neighbors in __init__
+    assert_raises(ValueError, neighbors.NearestNeighbors, n_neighbors=0)
